The '''Corsair Outback''' was a quadrant near the middle of the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes Cluster]]<ref name="TEA" /> and was of a medium size. In total, it contained only three inhabited [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] and was intersected by one [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace lane]].
